name: Return to The Night of the Zealot

campaign_notes.house_burned.text: your house has burned to the ground.

campaign_notes.ghoul_priest_alive.text: the Ghoul Priest is still alive.

campaign_notes.lita_finds_others.text: Lita was forced to find others to help her cause.

campaign_notes.arkham_succumbed.text: Arkham succumbed to Umôrdhoth’s terrible vengeance.

campaign_notes.ritual_broken.text: the ritual to summon Umôrdhoth was broken.

campaign_notes.lita_sacrificed.text: the investigators sacrificed Lita Chantler to Umôrdhoth.

zealots_revent.title: The Zealot's Revenge
zealots_revent.text: Have Lita Chantler’s [reaction] ability deal the killing blow to the Ghoul Priest.

dont_trust_her.title: I Don't Trust Her
dont_trust_her.text: When given the option to add Lita Chantler to your deck, refuse to do so.

insurance.title: Insurance Doesn’t Cover Ghouls
insurance.text: Burn your house to the ground in “The Gathering.”

do_i_have_to.title: …But Do I Have To?
do_i_have_to.text: In “The Midnight Masks,” have each investigator remain in Your House for the first three rounds.

conspiracy_of_silence.title: Conspiracy of Silence
conspiracy_of_silence.text: Find and interrogate all six unique cultists in “The Midnight Masks.”

tour_of_arkham.title: Tour of Arkham
tour_of_arkham.text: Trigger each of the “once per game” abilities on all of the locations in play in “The Midnight Masks.”

do_you_get_it_now.title: Do You Get It Now?
do_you_get_it_now.text: Trigger the Forced ability on Billy Cooper by defeating the Ghoul Priest at his location.

pinch_hitter.title: Pinch Hitter
pinch_hitter.text: Defeat three [[Ghoul]] enemies with a Baseball Bat without it breaking.

even_death_may_die.title: Even Death May Die
even_death_may_die.text: Defeat Umôrdhoth while the Vault of Earthly Demise is attached to it.

break_the_circle.title: Break the Circle
break_the_circle.text: Complete “The Devourer Below” without Umôrdhoth spawning.

theyre_just_misunderstood.title: They’re Just Misunderstood
theyre_just_misunderstood.text: Win the Night of the Zealot campaign without defeating a single unique [[Cultist]] enemy.

umordhoths_favor.title: Umôrdhoth’s Favor
umordhoths_favor.text: Win the Night of the Zealot campaign without defeating a single [[Ghoul]] enemy.

notz_line_in_the_sand.title: Line in the Sand
notz_line_in_the_sand.text: Win the Night of the Zealot campaign with at least three Ultimatums active.

arkham_expertise.title: Arkham Expertise
arkham_expertise.text: Win the Night of the Zealot campaign on Expert difficulty.
